Based on the official public roadmap and internal engineering updates, WorkflowCoach is currently in a restricted private beta phase, enabled for approximately 11% of active customers, primarily mid-market logistics and enterprise manufacturing clients such as Acme Manufacturing [NL-002#NL-002-S07] [NL-014#NL-014-S05]. The official public beta target is September 2026 [NL-002#NL-002-S07] [NL-014#NL-014-S05], with a specific release date of September 29, 2026, which will be available to all active Growth and Enterprise accounts [NL-014#NL-014-S03] [NL-014#NL-014-S05].

However, internal sources indicate the September target is in serious jeopardy. The CTO reported high latency during step transitions (up to 4 seconds) and issues with permission inheritance, where restricted documents are being exposed to unauthorized users, and provided a realistic engineering estimate of a November 2026 release [NL-015#NL-015-S05]. Internal roadmaps and standups also cite dependencies on the Advanced OCR Pipeline and Okta permission synchronization engine as delays, potentially slipping the public beta to November 2026 [NL-002#NL-002-S07] [NL-014#NL-014-S05].

Contingency plans specify a September private beta for customers with flat document structures and no sensitive compliance data, while deferring full permission-sync features (including cross-workspace permission synchronization) to the November public release [NL-015#NL-015-S05] [NL-015#NL-015-S09]. A draft internal product update on this contingency timeline is due July 5 [NL-015#NL-015-S09].

Planned core capabilities include ingesting procedural documents (checklists, compliance manuals, safety SOPs) and parsing them into sequential operational blocks, guiding users step-by-step with confirmations, photo uploads, or compliance questions [NL-002#NL-002-S07]. Every completed step is recorded in the tenant's compliance log, with skips or failed validations flagged and supervisors notified [NL-002#NL-002-S07] [NL-014#NL-014-S03]. The release brings a write-once PostgreSQL compliance log table that records timestamps, user IDs, and input payloads [NL-014#NL-014-S03].
